findings.title: Adding a series does not trigger range synchronization
findings.description: The range effect checks `seriesCountRef.current`, but adding or removing a series only mutates that ref (lines 146-151) and does not trigger a render. If a series is added while the range is unchanged, this effect will not run, so the current range is not applied until some other dependency—such as `range`—changes. Make the series count reactive or explicitly synchronize the range after a successful series addition.

findings.title: Later operation failures overwrite the documented first error
findings.description: `UseChartProviderResult` documents `error` as the first provider-operation error, but `setOperationError` replaces the current error on every failure. After multiple failed operations, the surfaced error is therefore the latest one, contrary to the stated contract. Preserve the first error or update the contract to specify that the latest error is reported.
